look_here_first: Erect narrow annual with flowers toward tip of ribbed leafy stem. Upper leaves and bracts narrow; pale-centered blue-violet flowers above smaller closed flowers below. Look for the unusually narrow long hypanthium below calyx; do not identify from one violet flower.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Small annual herb of the bellflower family; plant form and flowering-stem architecture help preliminary identification.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Lower leaves may be ovate/lanceolate and taper to a narrower base; upper bracts slender and less clasping.

key_traits.label: Flower
key_traits.text: Individual five-lobed usually blue-violet fused corolla at a stem leaf axil; upper open and lower closed flowers may coexist.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Long slender inferior capsule/hypanthium; pore location and width need verified voucher photo.

key_traits.label: Stem
key_traits.text: Alternate leafy annual stem with calyx and flower parts above an inferior ovary.
